argv:
import json,socket,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
p=json.loads(Path('governance/qualification/input.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
time.sleep(p['delay_ms']/1000)
escaped=False
for port in p['loopback_ports']:
 try:
  s=socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',port),timeout=.02);s.close();escaped=True;break
 except OSError: pass
pid=None
if p['mode']=='survivor':
 pid=subprocess.Popen(['/bin/sh','-c','exec -a ranex-slice036-survivor-control-v1 /bin/sleep 30'],start_new_session=True).pid
 time.sleep(.5)
value='oracle-mismatch' if p['mode']=='oracle-mismatch' else 'ok'
print(json.dumps({'flow_id':p['flow_id'],'network':'escaped' if escaped else 'denied','pid':pid,'task_id':p['task_id'],'value':value},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')))
raise SystemExit(91 if escaped or p['mode']=='network-control' else 0)
